**Finding: compliant** — no redline proposed.

§ 22 already sits at (indeed slightly above) our preferred audit position:

- **Frequency:** no more than once in any twelve-month period (§ 22.1)
- **Notice:** at least thirty days' prior written notice (§ 22.1)
- **Timing/manner:** normal business hours, no unreasonable disruption, off-site where practicable (§ 22.1)
- **Auditor:** independent and bound by confidentiality (§ 22.1)
- **Cost:** Vendor bears cost unless underpayment exceeds five percent (§ 22.2)
- **System access:** expressly barred — no direct access to our systems, unrelated Customer Data, privileged material or third-party confidential information (§ 22.2)

§ 22.3 adds further customer-side protection (audit findings are our Confidential Information, use limited to enforcement, copy of the final report, and payment of a shortfall closes the audited quantity issue). § 23 contains no operative records obligation, so there is nothing to double-flag.
